tools.name: survicate_list_surveys
tools.description: List the surveys in the workspace, newest first, with their type and metadata. Filter by creation date with start (newer bound) and end (older bound). Data Export API: GET /surveys.

tools.name: survicate_get_survey
tools.description: Get one survey by id: its name, status, type, and the names of respondent attributes sent with its responses (use these names in attribute lookups). Data Export API: GET /surveys/{survey_id}.

tools.name: survicate_list_questions
tools.description: List the questions of one survey, with their types and possible answers. Use it to map question ids to answers before reading responses. Data Export API: GET /surveys/{survey_id}/questions.

tools.name: survicate_list_responses
tools.description: List the responses of one survey, newest first, with answers, device, language and collected_at. Narrow by time range, by named attributes (attributes, up to 100 names) and by attribute filters. Data Export API: GET /surveys/{survey_id}/responses.

tools.name: survicate_get_response
tools.description: Get one response by uuid: answers, device, language, collected_at, the response's own attributes, and respondent attributes you name (up to 10). Data Export API: GET /surveys/{survey_id}/responses/{response_uuid}.

tools.name: survicate_list_respondent_responses
tools.description: List every survey response from one respondent across surveys, newest first. Response attribute arrays are empty here; read attributes with survicate_list_respondent_attributes. Data Export API: GET /respondents/{respondent_uuid}/responses.

tools.name: survicate_list_respondent_attributes
tools.description: List all attributes of one respondent (names and string values), including those synced from integrations. Data Export API: GET /respondents/{respondent_uuid}/attributes.
